episodes.title: In This Beautiful World of Ours

episodes.summary: A suspect in a disappearance case returns twenty years later, seeking out Soryong.

episodes.summary: A familiar face returns to Trigger after ten years, seeking help again for a renewed threat.

episodes.title: Inertia
episodes.summary: A surprising confession unsettles Han Do and Soryong. Cracks form within the Trigger team.

episodes.title: The Vanished Witness
episodes.summary: The team finds a new lead in a case, but the past is firmly sealed to unravel.

episodes.title: Cho Haewon
episodes.summary: As Soryong hunts for answers, Giho throws the team into chaos.

episodes.title: Oh, Soryong
episodes.summary: Soryong uncovers hidden truths behind the case from twenty years ago.

episodes.summary: Soryong and Han Do dig into a vast conspiracy, finally coming face-to-face with a shocking truth.

episodes.title: The Confession
episodes.summary: The Trigger team risks all to reveal the truth while fending off the villain's counterattacks.
